description: This file defines a DbService class that acts as a lightweight wrapper for SQLite database interactions, specifically targeting storage of Pomodoro session data. It includes methods for database initialization, record insertion, retrieval, and clearing of session records.

classes.name: DbService
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to interact with the sessions database, including opening, creating, inserting, retrieving, and clearing session data.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Lazy getter that initializes and returns the database instance, creating the database and table if they do not already exist.

methods.name: insertSession
methods.description: Inserts a new Session object into the database.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent sessions, sorted by newest first, with an optional limit.

methods.name: clearSessions
methods.description: Deletes all session records from the database.
